name.ja: 代数的マルチグリッド（AMG）
この実行例の式と条件

note.ja: 各行の最大非対角係数に対する相対強度からグラフを作り、貪欲な星型集約と余剰節点の隣接集約への付着で暫定補間Tを作ります。P=(I−ωD⁻¹A)T、ω=4/(3ρ̄)、ρ̄はD⁻¹Aの絶対行和上界です。粗演算子はPᵀAP。前後2回のJacobi平滑化と最終小行列の直接解を用います。これは採用した小規模SA変種であり、原著の全構築法や収束定理の再現ではありません。
note.en: A graph based on row-relative off-diagonal strength supplies greedy star aggregates; leftover nodes attach to adjacent aggregates. Smooth tentative T via P=(I−ωD⁻¹A)T with ω=4/(3ρ̄), where ρ̄ bounds the absolute row sums of D⁻¹A. Coarse operators are PᵀAP. V-cycles use two pre/post Jacobi sweeps and a terminal dense direct solve. This is a small adopted SA variant, not every construction or convergence theorem in the original paper.

note.en: Build a smoothed-aggregation hierarchy from an SPD matrix alone and run V-cycles. Problems with 7², 15² and 31² unknowns distinguish independent sparse direct solutions, analytic discrete sine modes and second-order convergence to the continuum solution.
